justification.text: `3 < k₁` is the problem's condition k₁ > 3, stated as a strict inequality in the informal text, so the boundary (k₁ ≥ 4) is the stated one.
`3 < k₂` is the problem's condition k₂ > 3, stated as a strict inequality in the informal text, so the boundary (k₂ ≥ 4) is the stated one.
`Finset.Icc 1 k₁` is the index set of the problem's product ∏_{1 ≤ i ≤ k₁}(m₁ + i), inclusive at both ends as the informal text writes it, so the factors are m₁ + 1, …, m₁ + k₁.
`Finset.Icc 1 k₂` is the index set of the problem's product ∏_{1 ≤ j ≤ k₂}(m₂ + j), inclusive at both ends as the informal text writes it, so the factors are m₂ + 1, …, m₂ + k₂.
